info.name: EventHub API — Authentication, Bookings & QR Tests
info.description: EventHub REST API tests: customer/admin authentication, public read endpoints, booking validation, customer access control, cancellation, and third-party QR generation. Run customer/admin login before protected requests. Variables for secrets are intentionally blank. Use an open, future event schedule for booking tests; the Cancel Booking test modifies data.

exec: pm.test("Customer Login: HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.have.header("Content-Type"); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/json"); });
let data = {}; try { data = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* JSON test will report failure */ }
pm.test("Response includes success flag", function () { pm.expect(data.success).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Logged in as customer", function () { pm.expect(data.user.role).to.eql("customer"); pm.expect(data.token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });
if (pm.response.code === 200 && data.user && data.user.role === "customer" && data.token) pm.collectionVariables.set("customer_token", data.token);

request.description: Requires active upcoming event schedule and sufficient tickets. Creates a real booking and saves its ID for QR/cancellation tests.

exec: pm.test("Create Booking: HTTP 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("Response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.have.header("Content-Type"); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/json"); });
let data = {}; try { data = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* JSON test will report failure */ }
pm.test("Response includes success flag", function () { pm.expect(data.success).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Booking reference returned", function () { pm.expect(data.booking_reference).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(data.booking_id).to.be.a("number"); });
if (pm.response.code === 201 && data.booking_id) { pm.collectionVariables.set("qr_booking_id", String(data.booking_id)); pm.collectionVariables.set("cancel_booking_id", String(data.booking_id)); }
